content.title: Board of Adjustment
content.summary: The Board of Adjustment addresses appeals related to the zoning ordinance and requests for variances to the Land Development Code, meeting at 6:15 pm on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month at City Hall. The board consists of seven members who serve three-year terms and receive $75 per meeting, with recruitment for vacancies starting in December. Public comments are welcomed during meetings, with submissions required by 5 pm the day before.
content.body:
## Overview

The Board of Adjustment hears all appeals of the zoning ordinance and requests for variance to the Land Development Code.

## Meeting Information

- 6:15 pm
- 1st and 3rd Tuesday of every month  
  If the 1st of the month falls on a Tuesday, the Board will meet on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of that month.
- City Hall
- Public comment is allowed during scheduled times on the agenda or during a public hearing. To submit public comment, [**please fill out this form**](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/64348). Comments can also be [sent via mail](/Directory.aspx?DID=45) to the Board of Adjustment. Members that wish to speak during the meeting may do so during the regularly scheduled public comment. All comments must be received by 5 pm the day before the meeting.

## Board Details

- 7 members
- 3 year terms
- Compensation: $75 per meeting
- Board members must be residents of Arvada

## Interested in Joining the Board of Adjustment?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
